TeliSIM MVNO - Telinta

# MVNO Solution

## for Service Providers

 

### TeliSIM MVNO Solution

TeliSIM TM brings eSIM technology into Telinta’s cloud-based platform. This enables you to start your own highly-profitable MVNO business for mobile data global roaming. Our solution includes mobile data, eSIMs, and a brandable mobile app. Users merely scan a convenient QR code with an eSIM-capable phone to begin using your service, without changing SIM cards.

In addition to mobile data, you can also offer voice and video calling “over the top” via our brandable TeliGlobe TM mobile softphone app for both Android and Apple iOS. Offer both SMS and MMS, plus free on-net messaging.

TeliSIM includes roaming agreements with over 500 mobile operators in over 100 countries around the world, and is specially designed for travelers while temporarily outside their home country. Multiple local phone numbers from your own DID providers can be used, as many different phone numbers as your user needs.

### Key Features

##### Key features

- Mobile Data
- Optional Mobile Softphone App
- eSIM capabilities, with convenient QR codes
- Ability to add as many DIDs as you need
- Real-time CDRs
- Easily manage eSIM accounts via an Administrative Portal
- Both prepaid and post-paid options
- Free recharge of a prepaid balance
- Your own VoIP Termination and DID providers
- Multi-language IVR
- Customizable portals for end users and resellers
- Multiple currencies

## White Label MVNO for you and your resellers!

## How does it work?

TeliSIM is a white label MVNO solution with eSIMs and mobile data for over 500 operators in over 100 countries, plus billing and account management. This solution is designed for international travelers while temporarily outside their home country, such as on a business trip or vacation. It is not designed to permanently replace the user’s local operator. Voice and video calling can be added “over the top” of TeliSIM’s mobile data (plus WiFI and other data sources) via our brandable mobile softphone, or any third-party app. SMS, MMS, and free on-net messaging is supported.

## How do you benefit?

With Telinta, you can easily enter the highly-attractive global market for mobile services, without investing in your own hardware, software, or roaming agreements. You and your resellers can use your own brand and your own prices. Our flexible billing enables you to create your own service bundles, both prepaid and postpaid. 24/7 technical support is ready to help you, 365 days per year. Our unique MVNO solution, plus our brandable mobile softphone for both Android and Apple iOS makes a powerful white label combination to win and retain both resellers and end users.

## Want to get started?

Telinta gives you a white label cloud-based solution to offer brandable eSIM and mobile data. When you become a Telinta customer, you have access to our complete portfolio, including TeliSIM and much more. We retain our customers with reliable service, and not with time-bound contracts. Telinta’s service agreements are month-to-month, so you are not locked in. We offer comprehensive training to help you get started, and 24/7 live award-winning technical support, every day of the year. Need help getting started with TeliSIM? Our engineers will be happy to help you, any time you need.
